title: Half-Life and Nuclear Equations

problems_fixed.what: Display was mis-posed for a single_value input: it said 'Write the mass number and atomic number ... (state both)' but only the atomic number can be typed. Reworded to ask for the atomic number only. Solution (91) and unit unchanged.
problems_fixed.old: Thorium-234 undergoes beta decay. Its mass number is 234 and atomic number is 90. Write the mass number and atomic number of the daughter nucleus (state both).
problems_fixed.new: Thorium-234 undergoes beta decay. Its mass number is 234 and atomic number is 90. What is the atomic number of the daughter nucleus?

problems_fixed.what: Every problem's misconception lacked the required `expect` key (validator failure). Rebuilt one honest misconception per problem with an `expect` derived by committing the specific error, each sitting well outside the answer window.
Added a plain-text `hint` to every problem (gold problems previously had neither hint nor equation_hint). Existing `equation_hint` recall toggles on bronze/silver kept byte-for-byte.

Slimmed method_card to 113 words (budget 140); added bronze/silver/gold tier descriptions; all preserved em dashes in exam_context.frequency and worked_examples labels converted to colons to satisfy the no-em-dash style gate.

problems_fixed.new: method_card 113 words; tier descriptions added; no em dashes

figures_note: No new figures. All existing per-problem half-life decay Chart.js configs were preserved byte-for-byte (illustrative % decay curves; they carry no problem-specific labels to mislabel). Nuclear-equation problems are pure recall and correctly carry no figure. Not an electricity lesson, so no circuit diagrams apply.
opener_concept: A glow stick that loses half its brightness every hour (80 -> 40 -> 20). Two common-sense halvings, then the reveal names the fixed halving time as the half-life and the method as repeated halving.
ladder_check: Bronze = halve a stated number of times (or recall an alpha/beta rule); Silver = find n = time / half-life then halve n times; Gold = work backwards in time (double), find an unknown time, or balance a decay. The existing bank already matched this ladder; no reordering needed.
notes: Shared scratchpad is used by many parallel fan-out agents; worked under uniquely-suffixed helper names and re-fetched the canonical to a private file to avoid clobbering. all_row_ids contains only the canonical OCR row, so exactly 1 row patched. Every guided box recomputed independently; every expect verified outside the answer window. g = not used (no gravity here). Live row validates clean; round-trip byte-identical.
